```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
movies_clean <- movies |> 
  separate_longer_delim(genre, delim = ", ")
```

```{r}
movies |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Rotten Tomatoes Critic Scores",
    subtitle = "29,783 films",
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count"
  )
```
